needs.role: Decorative stylized boundary/backdrop dressing for the practice arena perimeter
needs.constraints: Bright, stylized, cartoonish color palette; usable as a perimeter backdrop; must not contain gameplay scripts, health, combat or retaliation behavior; sized to enclose the arena footprint without blocking the sightline from spawn to the pedestal.

intent.experienceRole: Reinforces the requested bright, cartoonish practice-arena tone the player sees immediately from spawn, making the space feel like an authored fighting-game stage rather than a bare floor.
intent.interaction: Decorative only; players do not interact with it directly, it just frames the arena visually.
reusableFeatures: Existing stylized geometry/materials for an arena, ring or stage backdrop
Any built-in ambient trim, banners or lighting details that fit the cartoonish theme

needs.role: Raised, spotlit stage/pedestal prop for the dummy placement
needs.constraints: Must be a raised platform with a clear flat top able to hold a standing character-sized dummy; stylized/cartoonish; no embedded scripts controlling gameplay, health, or combat; may include an attached light fixture usable as a spotlight.

intent.experienceRole: Gives the training dummy an authored, clearly signposted stage the player is drawn toward from spawn, establishing the arena's visual focal point.
intent.interaction: Decorative structural prop; the player walks up to it but the pedestal itself has no interactive behavior—the dummy placed on top is what the player later punches.
reusableFeatures: Existing raised platform geometry with a flat top sized for a standing character
Any embedded spotlight or light fixture matching a stylized stage look

needs.role: Small fist/glove icon image displayed beside the HUD hit counter numeral
needs.constraints: Bold, simple, cartoonish icon readable at small HUD size; ideally transparent background; must be a standalone image usable in an ImageLabel; no embedded gameplay scripts or behavior expected.

intent.experienceRole: Reinforces the fighting-game HUD identity at a glance, pairing the numeral with a recognizable combat icon consistent with the arena's cartoonish tone.
intent.interaction: Purely decorative; a static icon displayed beside the hit counter number, never clicked or otherwise interactive.
reusableFeatures: Existing icon image asset with a clean, transparent background suitable for direct ImageLabel use without further editing

needs.constraints: Acquire the exact approved reference #1245720733. Import the selected Marketplace Training Dummy asset (1245720733) into the arena, inspect its full hierarchy and its one embedded script, and ensure the resulting instance is anchored/stationary, has no health or damage-taking system, and never attacks back. Disable or remove any embedded logic that would deal damage, retaliate, or otherwise deviate from a passive target.

Acquire the exact approved reference #12061946559. Inspect the Marketplace R15 Punching Animations asset (12061946559) hierarchy, its one embedded script, and confirm clip key 1/1/18/1 resolves to a playable R15 punch Animation usable by an Animator, verifying it is safe to integrate (no unrelated gameplay logic) before CombatService references it. Preserve the selected embedded clip 1/1/18/1. A preview is not runtime playback verification.

Acquire the exact approved reference #132504023010884. Resolve and inspect the 'Punch Impact 1' Marketplace sound asset (132504023010884) to confirm it is a valid, loadable Sound with a usable SoundId before it is referenced by the client effects script.

Acquire the exact approved reference #86089736228455. Import and statically inspect the 'Hit vfx m1 boxing' Marketplace model (86089736228455): document its ParticleEmitters/Beams/Attachments/effect parts, confirm it contains no unrelated scripts or gameplay logic, and verify it is a self-contained, clonable visual effect suitable for spawning at a hit position.

unbackedModelCheck.detail: A provided model or mesh ID is only a reference. Acquire its actual hierarchy through the native asset pipeline before claiming integration. Empty containers are not imported assets.
